# A Story for the Lane

*The children of the lane now ask whether the Balrog is coming back. Winifred wants a happy ending she can stand behind: a meadow that was safe for her as a girl, walked and made safe again.*

## Objectives

1. Defeat 30 [Green Mushroom](../monsters/green_mushroom.md) in [The Waystone Meadows](../maps/waystone_meadows.md)
2. Reach the shepherd's hut in [The Waystone Meadows](../maps/waystone_meadows.md)
3. Talk to [Hodge](../npcs/hodge.md)
